```artifact
**UML Testing Profile (UTP)**

**Requirement U32_13**

**Test Case TC-001**
**Title:** Verify Back-up Rotation
**Requirement IDs:** [Req-13]
**Kind:** Positive
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Inputs:** None
**Steps:**
- Verify that a full back-up of the system is taken every night.
- Verify that the back-up is sent to the remote site.
- Verify that the back-up is rotated every 30 days.

**Expected:**
- Back-up file is created and stored at the remote site.
- Back-up file is rotated every 30 days.

**Test Case TC-002**
**Title:** Verify Back-up Failure
**Requirement IDs:** [Req-13]
**Kind:** Negative
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Inputs:** None
**Steps:**
- Simulate a failure in the backup process.
**Expected:**
- Error message is displayed indicating the failure.

**Test Case TC-003**
**Title:** Verify Code Backup Failure
**Requirement IDs:** [Req-13]
**Kind:** Negative
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Inputs:** None
**Steps:**
- Simulate a failure in the code backup process.
**Expected:**
- Error message is displayed indicating the failure.

**Requirement U32_14**

**Test Case TC-004**
**Title:** Verify Patient Authentication
**Requirement IDs:** [VIRTUA-13-2]
**Kind:** Positive
**Preconditions:** Patient has registered
**Inputs:** User ID, Password
**Steps:**
- Enter the user ID and password.
**Expected:**
- Patient is logged in successfully.

**Test Case TC-005**
**Title:** Verify Incorrect Password
**Requirement IDs:** [VIRTUA-13-2]
**Kind:** Negative
**Preconditions:** Patient has registered
**Inputs:** User ID, Incorrect Password
**Steps:**
- Enter the user ID and incorrect password.
**Expected:**
- Error message is displayed indicating the incorrect password.

**Test Case TC-006**
**Title:** Verify Report Date Boundaries
**Requirement IDs:** [VIRTUA-13-3.2, VIRTUA-13-3.3]
**Kind:** Boundary
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Inputs:** Last day of the month, 5-day window
**Steps:**
- Run the report for the last day of the month.
- Run the report for the 5-day window.
**Expected:**
- Report is generated for the specified date range.
```
